arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, per their own web search, can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. This needs your consent. Please tell us: (1) do you agree to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) who pays to disconnect and remove the existing LG and fit the new one; (3) what should happen to the LG (inspect, repair, dispose, keep); (4) or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect/repair it first? Please reply by 2025-07-29.
options: Agree to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal/fitting and what happens to the LG
Our contractor inspects the LG first
Landlord arranges own contractor/replacement
Decline

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with own machine. Not a repair: needs landlord consent. Tenant's machine stays theirs, is not on the inventory and leaves with them. Landlord asked about payment for disconnect/removal/fitting and disposal of existing LG. Tenant's claim of unrepairable is unverified (own web search). Cat: appliance, routine.

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the LG belongs to the landlord, fitting your own needs their agreement, so we've asked them. We've also asked who covers removing the old machine and fitting the new one, and what happens to the LG. Please don't remove or replace anything until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 29 July.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (here when they moved in) has a power failure and, per their own web search, can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. This needs your consent. Please tell us: (1) do you agree to the tenant fitting their own machine; (2) who pays to disconnect and remove the existing LG and fit the new one; (3) what should happen to the LG (inspect, repair, dispose, keep); (4) or would you prefer we send our contractor to inspect/repair it first? Please reply by 2025-07-29.
options: Agree to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal/fitting and what happens to the LG
Our contractor inspects the LG first
Landlord arranges own contractor/replacement
Decline

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with own machine. Not a repair: needs landlord consent. Tenant's machine stays theirs, is not on the inventory and leaves with them. Landlord asked about payment for disconnect/removal/fitting and disposal of existing LG. Tenant's claim of unrepairable is unverified (own web search). Cat: appliance, routine.

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the LG belongs to the landlord, fitting your own needs their agreement, so we've asked them. We've also asked who covers removing the old machine and fitting the new one, and what happens to the LG. Please don't remove or replace anything until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 29 July.
